    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "\n",
        "csv_path = \"/kaggle/input/creditcardfraud/creditcard.csv\"\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Dataset shape:\", df.shape)\n",
        "print(\"\\nClass distribution:\")\n",
        "print(df[\"Class\"].value_counts())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "8-Uwr7u2qDu5",
        "outputId": "4656d631-742d-43b9-9d11-a9dad40b1186"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Dataset shape: (284807, 31)\n",
            "\n",
            "Class distribution:\n",
            "Class\n",
            "0    284315\n",
            "1       492\n",
            "Name: count, dtype: int64\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "\n",
        "X = df.drop(\"Class\", axis=1)\n",
        "y = df[\"Class\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X, y,\n",
        "    test_size=0.2,\n",
        "    stratify=y,\n",
        "    random_state=42\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Training:\", X_train.shape)\n",
        "print(\"Testing:\", X_test.shape)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "5Dhz1BfjqMVJ",
        "outputId": "91f22f84-f749-459d-b253-baf2fac0c72f"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Training: (227845, 30)\n",
            "Testing: (56962, 30)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from xgboost import XGBClassifier\n",
        "\n",
        "scale_pos_weight = (y_train == 0).sum() / (y_train == 1).sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "model = XGBClassifier(\n",
        "    n_estimators=150,\n",
        "    max_depth=5,\n",
        "    learning_rate=0.08,\n",
        "    subsample=0.9,\n",
        "    colsample_bytree=0.9,\n",
        "    scale_pos_weight=scale_pos_weight,\n",
        "    eval_metric=\"logloss\",\n",
        "    tree_method=\"hist\",\n",
        "    n_jobs=-1,\n",
        "    random_state=42\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"XGBoost training completed ✅\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "KiDYqEnnqUmQ",
        "outputId": "5f5cec79-6080-4685-b668-054ed28ba93b"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "XGBoost training completed ✅\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.metrics import (\n",
        "    roc_auc_score,\n",
        "    average_precision_score,\n",
        "    precision_score,\n",
        "    recall_score,\n",
        "    f1_score\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "y_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]\n",
        "y_pred = (y_prob >= 0.5).astype(int)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"ROC-AUC :\", round(roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob), 4))\n",
        "print(\"PR-AUC  :\", round(average_precision_score(y_test, y_prob), 4))\n",
        "print(\"Precision:\", round(precision_score(y_test, y_pred), 4))\n",
        "print(\"Recall   :\", round(recall_score(y_test, y_pred), 4))\n",
        "print(\"F1-score :\", round(f1_score(y_test, y_pred), 4))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "cS9WogJ8qdqk",
        "outputId": "2743cb2f-2452-495d-819e-3d2c037de0b5"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "ROC-AUC : 0.9816\n",
            "PR-AUC  : 0.8565\n",
            "Precision: 0.6614\n",
            "Recall   : 0.8571\n",
            "F1-score : 0.7467\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "[k for k in globals() if \"xgb\" in k.lower()]"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"

        "id": "tddep_W1qyeB",
        "outputId": "4a567372-f775-45a7-9110-978402db9862"
      },
      "execution_count": null,

            ]
          },

        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import shap\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train XGBoost again and save it as xgb_model\n",
        "xgb_model = XGBClassifier(\n",
        "    n_estimators=150,\n",
        "    max_depth=5,\n",
        "    learning_rate=0.08,\n",
        "    subsample=0.9,\n",
        "    colsample_bytree=0.9,\n",
        "    scale_pos_weight=(y_train == 0).sum() / (y_train == 1).sum(),\n",
        "    eval_metric=\"logloss\",\n",
        "    tree_method=\"hist\",\n",
        "    n_jobs=-1,\n",
        "    random_state=42\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "xgb_model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"XGBoost model ready ✅\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "HsKiUSmMrTA9",
        "outputId": "481c16ed-83d1-4e7e-8be1-cc198ed3c042"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "XGBoost model ready ✅\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Select 1000 test samples for SHAP\n",
        "X_shap = X_test.sample(1000, random_state=42)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create SHAP explainer\n",
        "explainer = shap.TreeExplainer(xgb_model)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate SHAP values\n",
        "shap_values = explainer.shap_values(X_shap)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"SHAP analysis completed ✅\")\n",
        "print(\"Samples analyzed:\", len(X_shap))\n",
        "print(\"Features analyzed:\", X_shap.shape[1])"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "op3yuK4Rra4S",
        "outputId": "04184ceb-28ef-4f51-ec24-f35b8a671362"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "SHAP analysis completed ✅\n",
            "Samples analyzed: 1000\n",
            "Features analyzed: 30\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# SHAP feature importance\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))\n",
        "\n",
        "shap.summary_plot(\n",
        "    shap_values,\n",
        "    X_shap,\n",
        "    plot_type=\"bar\",\n",
        "    show=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"FinGuard AI - SHAP Feature Importance\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig(\"FinGuard_shap_feature_importance.png\", dpi=300, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"SHAP feature importance graph saved ✅\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 356
        },
        "id": "nrpfAhq1rhJE",
        "outputId": "04fe1aea-37db-4363-8181-22db916614a0"
      },

          },

        {
          "output_type": "stream",

            "SHAP feature importance graph saved ✅\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate mean absolute SHAP importance\n",
        "shap_importance = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Feature\": X_shap.columns,\n",
        "    \"Mean_Absolute_SHAP\": np.abs(shap_values).mean(axis=0)\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "# Sort from most important to least important\n",
        "shap_importance = shap_importance.sort_values(\n",
        "    \"Mean_Absolute_SHAP\",\n",
        "    ascending=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Save results\n",
        "shap_importance.to_csv(\n",
        "    \"FinGuard_shap_feature_importance.csv\",\n",
        "    index=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"SHAP numerical results saved ✅\")\n",
        "print(shap_importance.head(10))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Explain one transaction using SHAP\n",
        "\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Select one test transaction\n",
        "transaction = X_test.iloc[[0]]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate SHAP values for this transaction\n",
        "transaction_shap = explainer.shap_values(transaction)\n",
        "\n",
        "# SHAP waterfall explanation\n",
        "shap.plots._waterfall.waterfall_legacy(\n",
        "    explainer.expected_value,\n",
        "    transaction_shap[0],\n",
        "    transaction.iloc[0],\n",
        "    feature_names=transaction.columns,\n",
        "    show=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"FinGuard AI - Individual Fraud Explanation\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import precision_score, recall_score, f1_score\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "thresholds = np.arange(0.10, 0.91, 0.05)\n",
        "\n",
        "results = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for threshold in thresholds:\n",
        "    y_pred_threshold = (y_prob >= threshold).astype(int)\n",
        "\n",
        "    results.append({\n",
        "        \"Threshold\": round(threshold, 2),\n",
        "        \"Precision\": precision_score(y_test, y_pred_threshold, zero_division=0),\n",
        "        \"Recall\": recall_score(y_test, y_pred_threshold, zero_division=0),\n",
        "        \"F1\": f1_score(y_test, y_pred_threshold, zero_division=0)\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "threshold_results = pd.DataFrame(results)\n",
        "\n",
        "threshold_results.to_csv(\n",
        "    \"FinGuard_threshold_analysis.csv\",\n",
        "    index=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
        "plt.plot(threshold_results[\"Threshold\"], threshold_results[\"Precision\"], marker=\"o\", label=\"Precision\")\n",
        "plt.plot(threshold_results[\"Threshold\"], threshold_results[\"Recall\"], marker=\"o\", label=\"Recall\")\n",
        "plt.plot(threshold_results[\"Threshold\"], threshold_results[\"F1\"], marker=\"o\", label=\"F1-score\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Classification Threshold\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Score\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"FinGuard AI - Threshold Trade-off\")\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.savefig(\n",
        "    \"FinGuard_threshold_tradeoff.png\",\n",
        "    dpi=300,\n",
        "    bbox_inches=\"tight\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"✅ Threshold analysis created\")\n",
        "print(\"✅ FinGuard_threshold_analysis.csv\")\n",
        "print(\"✅ FinGuard_threshold_tradeoff.png\")"
      ],
